ma-sec-2026-sl-primary-results.agency: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, Elections Division
ma-sec-2026-sl-primary-results.title: PD43+ Certified Election Results: 2026 State Primary (September 1, 2026), Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, Auditor, Governor's Council, State Senate and State Representative
ma-sec-2026-sl-primary-results.note: The PD43+ searches for 2026 and office_id 3, 4, 12, 45, 53, 90, 529, 9 and 8: 428 party primaries (277 with candidates), names, votes, winner marks and write-in labels only. A field is a party primary with two or more printed candidates. The special elections listed for 2026 are not on the November ballot and are left out: State Senate 1st Middlesex Special General Election (2026-03-03); State Senate 1st Middlesex Special Democratic Primary (2026-02-03); State Senate 1st Middlesex Special Republican Primary (2026-02-03); State Representative 5th Essex Special General Election (2026-03-31); State Representative 5th Essex Special Democratic Primary (2026-03-03); State Representative 5th Essex Special Republican Primary (2026-03-03). The primary's date is read from PD43+'s own election page. Kept as the figures read (the SHA-256 is of that JSON).

ma-openstates-roster.title: Sitting Massachusetts legislators and statewide officers
ma-openstates-roster.note: Who holds each legislative seat today (chamber and district), and the Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Treasurer, Auditor and Secretary of the Commonwealth (the roster's "chief election officer"); the roster lists the Lieutenant Governor twice (Kim and Kimberly Driscoll) and the record with the later term end is used; it carries no Governor's Councillors.
